WITH top_categories AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, 'Unknown') AS product_category_name_english
  FROM order_items oit
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oit.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oit.product_id
  JOIN product_category_translation pct ON pct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= (
    (SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) FROM orders) - INTERVAL '24 months'
  )
  GROUP BY COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, 'Unknown')
  ORDER BY ABS(SUM(oit.price)) DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT
  to_char(o.order_purchase_timestamp::date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, 'Unknown') AS product_category_name_english,
  ABS(SUM(oit.price)) AS monthly_sales
FROM order_items oit
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oit.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oit.product_id
JOIN product_category_translation pct ON pct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
JOIN top_categories tc ON tc.product_category_name_english = COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, 'Unknown')
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= (
  (SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) FROM orders) - INTERVAL '24 months'
)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 ASC, 2 ASC;
